DEFINE INSTRUMENT powder_diffractometer (
lambda = 2.5666, // Angstrom] Wavelength in Angstrom
R = 0.87, // Low-angle reflectivity R for straight guides
R_curve = 0.87, // Low-angle reflectivity R for curved guide
string filename = "Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz", // Powder reflection file
D_PHI = 6.0, // d_phi focus range
SHIFT = 0.0, // Detector shift
PACK = 0.7, // Packing factor
Dw = 0.8, // Debye-Waller factor
BARNS = 1.0, // Barns flag
SPLITS = 58.0 // Split parameter for sample
)

DECLARE 
%{
double mono_q = 1.8734;
double y_mono = 0.025;
double NV = 5.0;
double sample_radius = 0.004;
double sample_height = 0.03;
double can_radius = 0.00415;
double can_height = 0.0303;
double can_thick = 0.00015;
double Qc = 0.0217;
double R0 = 0.995;
double Mvalue = 1.9;
double W = 0.004;
double Qc_curve = 0.0217;
double R0_curve = 0.995;
double Mvalue_curve = 2.1;
double W_curve = 0.004;
double ldiff = 0.05;
double TTM = 0.0;
double OMA = 0.0;
double RV = 0.0;
double angleGuideCurved = 0.0;
double alpha = 0.0;
double alpha_curve = 0.0;
%}

INITIALIZE 
%{
// Start of initialize for generated powder_diffractometer
%}

TRACE 
COMPONENT source_arm = Progress_bar()
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT source = Source_Maxwell_3(
 yheight = 0.156, xwidth = 0.126,
 Lmin = lambda-ldiff/2, Lmax = lambda+ldiff/2,
 dist = 1.725, focus_xw = 0.02,
 focus_yh = 0.12, T1 = 296.16,
 T2 = 40.68, I1 = 850000000000,
 I2 = 520000000000)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE source_arm

COMPONENT PSDbefore_guides = PSD_monitor(
 nx = 128, ny = 128,
 filename = "PSDbefore_guides", xwidth = 0.02,
 yheight = 0.12, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 1.49999) RELATIVE source_arm

COMPONENT l_mon_source = L_monitor(
 nL = 101, filename = "lmonsource.dat",
 xwidth = 0.02, yheight = 0.12,
 Lmin = 0, Lmax = 20,
 restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 1e-09) RELATIVE PSDbefore_guides

COMPONENT guide1 = Guide(
 w1 = 0.02, h1 = 0.12,
 w2 = 0.02, h2 = 0.12,
 l = 4.66, R0 = R0,
 Qc = Qc, alpha = (R0-R)/Qc/(Mvalue-1),
 m = 1.8, W = W)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 1.5) RELATIVE source_arm

COMPONENT PSDbefore_curve = PSD_monitor(
 nx = 128, ny = 128,
 filename = "PSDbefore_curve", xwidth = 0.02,
 yheight = 0.12, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 4.664) RELATIVE guide1

COMPONENT guide2 = Bender(
 w = 0.02, h = 0.12,
 r = 3612, l = 20,
 R0a = R0_curve, Qca = Qc_curve,
 alphaa = (R0_curve-R_curve)/Qc_curve/(Mvalue_curve-1), ma = Mvalue_curve,
 Wa = W_curve, R0i = R0_curve,
 Qci = Qc_curve, alphai = (R0_curve-R_curve)/Qc_curve/(Mvalue_curve-1),
 mi = 1, Wi = W_curve,
 R0s = R0_curve, Qcs = Qc_curve,
 alphas = (R0_curve-R_curve)/Qc_curve/(Mvalue_curve-1), ms = Mvalue_curve,
 Ws = W_curve)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 4.69) RELATIVE guide1

COMPONENT PSDafter_curve = PSD_monitor(
 nx = 128, ny = 128,
 filename = "PSDafter_curve", xwidth = 0.02,
 yheight = 0.12, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 20.0001) RELATIVE guide2

COMPONENT bunker = Guide(
 w1 = 0.02, h1 = 0.12,
 w2 = 0.02, h2 = 0.12,
 l = 3.43, R0 = R0,
 Qc = Qc, alpha = (R0-R)/Qc/(Mvalue-1),
 m = 1.6, W = W)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 20.1502) RELATIVE guide2
ROTATED (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE guide2

COMPONENT guide3 = Guide(
 w1 = 0.02, h1 = 0.12,
 w2 = 0.02, h2 = 0.12,
 l = 12.275, R0 = R0,
 Qc = Qc, alpha = (R0-R)/Qc/(Mvalue-1),
 m = 1.6, W = W)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 3.56) RELATIVE bunker
ROTATED (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE bunker

COMPONENT guide4 = Guide(
 w1 = 0.02, h1 = 0.12,
 w2 = 0.02, h2 = 0.12,
 l = 5.66, R0 = R0,
 Qc = Qc, alpha = (R0-R)/Qc/(Mvalue-1),
 m = 1.6, W = W)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 15.8555) RELATIVE bunker
ROTATED (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE bunker

COMPONENT window1 = Al_window(
 thickness = 0.002)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 5.660000001) RELATIVE guide4

COMPONENT ydist_fluxpos = PSDlin_monitor(
 nbins = 11, filename = "ydist_fluxpos.dat",
 xwidth = 0.12, yheight = 0.02,
 restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 5.67000001) RELATIVE guide4
ROTATED (0.0, 0.0, 90.0) RELATIVE guide4

COMPONENT PSD_fluxpos = PSD_monitor(
 nx = 100, ny = 100,
 filename = "xdist_fluxposy.dat", xwidth = 0.02,
 yheight = 0.12, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 5.6700001) RELATIVE guide4

COMPONENT xdist_flux_pos = PSDlin_monitor(
 nbins = 11, filename = "xdist_fluxpos.dat",
 xwidth = 0.02, yheight = 0.12,
 restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 1e-09) RELATIVE PSD_fluxpos

COMPONENT PSD_fluxposB = PSD_monitor(
 nx = 100, ny = 100,
 filename = "PSD_fluxposB.dat", xwidth = 0.02,
 yheight = 0.12, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 6.2299999) RELATIVE guide4

COMPONENT window2 = Al_window(
 thickness = 0.002)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 1e-09) RELATIVE PSD_fluxposB

COMPONENT in_slit = Slit(
 xmin = -0.01, xmax = 0.01,
 ymin = -0.06, ymax = 0.06)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0021) RELATIVE window2

COMPONENT lambda_in = L_monitor(
 nL = 128, filename = "L_in.dat",
 xmin = -0.011, xmax = 0.011,
 ymin = -0.061, ymax = 0.061,
 Lmin = 0, Lmax = 2*lambda,
 restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.001) RELATIVE in_slit

COMPONENT sma = Arm()
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.65) RELATIVE in_slit
ROTATED (0.0, OMA, 0.0) RELATIVE in_slit

SPLIT 10 COMPONENT foc_mono = Monochromator_2foc(
 zwidth = 0.05, yheight = 0.025,
 gap = 0.0005, NH = 1,
 NV = NV, mosaich = 38,
 mosaicv = 38, r0 = 0.7,
 Q = mono_q, RV = RV,
 RH = 0)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE sma

COMPONENT msa = Arm()
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE sma
ROTATED (0.0, TTM, 0.0) RELATIVE sma

COMPONENT out1_slit = Slit(
 xmin = -0.01, xmax = 0.01,
 ymin = -0.06, ymax = 0.06)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.2) RELATIVE msa

COMPONENT Amoin_slit = Slit(
 xmin = -0.01, xmax = 0.01,
 ymin = -0.06, ymax = 0.06)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.325) RELATIVE msa

COMPONENT Bmoin_slit = Slit(
 xmin = -0.01, xmax = 0.01,
 ymin = -0.06, ymax = 0.06)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.525) RELATIVE msa

COMPONENT out2_slit = Slit(
 xmin = -0.01, xmax = 0.01,
 ymin = -0.06, ymax = 0.06)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.65) RELATIVE msa

COMPONENT PSD_sample = PSD_monitor(
 nx = 80, ny = 80,
 filename = "PSD_sample.dat", xmin = -0.05,
 xmax = 0.05, ymin = -0.07,
 ymax = 0.07, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 2.77) RELATIVE msa

COMPONENT lambda_sample = L_monitor(
 nL = 128, filename = "L_sample.dat",
 xmin = -sample_radius, xmax = sample_radius,
 ymin = -sample_height/2, ymax = sample_height/2,
 Lmin = lambda-0.2, Lmax = lambda+0.2,
 restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 2.81) RELATIVE msa

COMPONENT sa_arm = Arm()
AT (0.0, 0.0, 2.82) RELATIVE msa

COMPONENT sample = PowderN(
 reflections = filename, radius = sample_radius,
 yheight = sample_height, pack = PACK,
 p_inc = 0, p_transmit = 0,
 DW = Dw, d_phi = D_PHI,
 barns = BARNS)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE sa_arm

COMPONENT STOP = Beamstop(
 radius = 0.3)
AT (0.0, 0.0, 1.4) RELATIVE sa_arm

COMPONENT Detector = Monitor_nD(
 xwidth = 3, yheight = 0.09,
 bins = 400, min = 19.9+SHIFT,
 max = 99.9+SHIFT, options = "banana,theta",
 filename = "detector.dat")
AT (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) RELATIVE sa_arm
ROTATED (0.0, 0.0, 180.0) RELATIVE sa_arm

FINALLY 
%{
// Start of finally for generated powder_diffractometer
%}

END
"}

### Instrument Architecture & Implementation Summary
- **Source**: `Source_Maxwell_3` thermal source focused toward the guide entrance.
- **Guide System**: Initial straight guide (`guide1`), curved bender (`guide2`), bunker guide (`bunker`), intermediate guide (`guide3`), and primary instrument guide (`guide4`).
- **Monochromator**: `Monochromator_2foc` placed on double-mosaicity/focusing arms (`sma` and `msa`), calculating take-off angle $2\theta_m$ (`TTM`) and Bragg angle $\theta_m$ (`OMA`) based on $\lambda = 2.5666\text{ \AA}$ and $Q = 1.8734\text{ \AA}^{-1}$.
- **Sample & Slits**: Collimation slits (`in_slit`, `out1_slit`, `Amoin_slit`, `Bmoin_slit`, `out2_slit`) leading to a `PowderN` sample (`Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz`).
- **Detectors & Monitors**: Position-sensitive and wavelength monitors along the beamline, ending with a curved 1D `Monitor_nD` banana detector spanning $19.9^\circ \le 2\theta \le 99.9^\circ$.
